name: Tourist visa
summary: Tourist visa valid 3 months with a 1 month stay. No work allowed. Needs an invitation letter from Afghanistan and an itinerary.

other: Applicants with criminal records are denied.

Source is an Afghan consulate page. It does not say which authority runs it today. Afghanistan has a major security and political situation, and many governments advise against travel. Check your own government's travel advice and confirm the visa in writing before you go. No fees or rules below are guaranteed.
